waitlist-welcome.name: Waitlist welcome
waitlist-welcome.sent: Automatically, by /api/waitlist, the second someone signs up.
waitlist-welcome.when: Confirms their place, gives them the referral link (the only thing that moves them up), and sets the expectation: one email when it's their turn.
waitlist-welcome.subject: You're #{{positionFmt}} in line for Evochi. Your {{colourName}} egg is reserved.
waitlist-welcome.preheader: Bring a friend and you both move up. Your link is inside.
altSubjects: Your {{colourName}} egg is reserved (#{{positionFmt}} in line)
You're in. Here's how to move up the Evochi waitlist.

tokens.colour: amber | forest | coral | ocean | amethyst | obsidian
tokens.founder: true for the first 1,000 sign-ups (shows the crown block and the crowned egg)
tokens.count / goal: live sign-up count and the hatch goal

referral-moved-up.name: Referral: you moved up
referral-moved-up.sent: Automatically, by /api/waitlist, to the referrer when a friend joins with their link.
referral-moved-up.when: The reward loop. Short, one button, sends them straight back to sharing.
referral-moved-up.subject: Someone hatched with your link. You're now #{{positionFmt}}.
referral-moved-up.preheader: {{referrals}} {{friendWord}} on board. Every extra one moves you up again.
altSubjects: Your link worked: #{{positionFmt}} in line now

tokens.referrals: friends who joined with their link

hatch-progress.name: Hatch progress (milestone)
hatch-progress.sent: By hand, from Resend Broadcasts or your newsletter tool, at 25%, 50%, 75% and 90% of the goal.
hatch-progress.when: Keeps the list warm without a product to show. Three real updates, the meter, and the share link. Change the updates every time; never send the same three twice.
hatch-progress.subject: {{countFmt}} of {{goalFmt}}. Mochi's egg is {{pct}}% hatched.
altSubjects: {{countFmt}} people are waiting on an egg

tokens.refLink: the reader's link (merge from your ESP, or link to the site)

sample.milestoneLine: Halfway. At this pace the egg hatches in about three weeks, and the first invites go out the same day.
updates: The Elder's back view is finished (yes, all of it). Full turn in the latest dev diary.
Health Connect on Android reads steps in the background now, so overnight walks count.
Six colours confirmed for beta. A secret seventh is being voted on in the comments.

beta-invite.name: Beta invite
beta-invite.sent: By hand, in batches of 100-200, earliest in line first. Resend Broadcasts or your ESP with the merge fields below.
beta-invite.when: The one email you promised. Two buttons, install steps, and a clear ask for feedback. Expiry keeps spots moving.
beta-invite.subject: Your egg is ready to hatch. Evochi beta, {{expiresDays}}-day invite inside.
beta-invite.preheader: iPhone (TestFlight) and Android (Google Play) links. Yours for {{expiresDays}} days.
altSubjects: It's your turn: the Evochi beta is open
You waited. Your egg is ready.

tokens.testflightUrl / playUrl: the public TestFlight link and the Play Store beta opt-in link
tokens.expiresDays: how long the invite is held
tokens.betaNote: an optional sentence about progress carrying over to launch (only promise it if the app does it)

beta-reminder.name: Beta reminder
beta-reminder.sent: By hand, 3 days before an unclaimed invite expires.
beta-reminder.when: A gentle nudge with an easy out. The 'skip' reply keeps the list honest and the person on it for launch.
beta-reminder.subject: Your Evochi beta spot is still waiting ({{daysLeft}} days left)
beta-reminder.preheader: After that it goes to the next person in line. Reply 'skip' if now's not the time.
altSubjects: {{daysLeft}} days left on your beta invite

dev-diary.name: Dev diary (newsletter)
dev-diary.sent: By hand, every two or three weeks at most. One topic per issue.
dev-diary.when: The same voice as the videos: one thing you made, one picture, one question people can answer by replying. Replies are the point; they train the inbox to trust you.
dev-diary.subject: Dev diary #{{issue}}: {{title}}

tokens.heroImage / heroAlt: one picture: a file name from assets/email (elder-ocean.png, family-ocean.png) or any full https:// image URL, 1040px wide
tokens.paragraphs: two to four short paragraphs (HTML allowed)
tokens.question: the one question to reply to
tokens.ctaUrl / ctaLabel: the button, usually the latest video

sample.title: Yes, I modelled the back
sample.preheaderLine: Someone asked. So here's the Elder from every angle, and a question about colours.
paragraphs: A few of you asked whether the Elder has a back, or whether I'd just been clever with camera angles. It has a back. It has 118,000 voxels and most of them are crest, and I spent a week on a side nobody will see unless they rotate the EvoDex.

That week also fixed something real: the turn-around views are now what the game uses for the Evolution screen, so the reveal spins the whole creature instead of flipping a sprite. It looks like a toy on a turntable. I'm happy with it.
thisWeek: Elder turnaround in the game, all six colours.
Health Connect background sync on Android (overnight walks count).
Rest days: two protected days a week, so a cold doesn't make your Evochi sick.
sample.question: If there were a seventh colour, what would it be? One word is fine.

launch-day.name: Launch day
launch-day.sent: By hand, to the whole list, the morning the store listings go live.
launch-day.when: Two store buttons above the fold, a thank-you, the crown reminder for founders, and three tips that make the first week go well.
launch-day.subject: Evochi is out. Hatch yours.
launch-day.preheader: On the App Store and Google Play today. Free, no ads, your steps stay yours.
altSubjects: It hatched. Evochi is on the App Store and Google Play.
Launch day: your egg is waiting

account-deletion.name: Account deletion received
account-deletion.sent: By hand (or from your support tool) in reply to a request from evochigame.com/delete-account.html.
account-deletion.when: Google Play requires a way to delete an account from outside the app; this is the confirmation. Plain, specific, with a cancel window.
account-deletion.subject: Your Evochi account deletion request
account-deletion.preheader: Received {{requestDate}}. Deleted within {{windowDays}} days. Reply within {{cancelDays}} days to cancel.

tokens.windowDays: your deletion window (the privacy policy says 30)
tokens.items: the list of what gets deleted; match it to the privacy policy

items: Your account and sign-in (Apple, Google or email)
Your Evochi: name, colour, level, XP, mood history and the EvoDex
Items, EvoCoins and the Hall of Memories
